criterion: Use purged/embargoed splits for overlapping holding horizons and nearby events; no feature, target, label, or revision from after decision time enters fitting.
test_result: 10 learned-model and temporal-split tests passed; Ruff and targeted mypy passed; source and strategy-variant inventory checks passed (618 Python files, 253 linked candidates). CI pending.

Reserved validation rows are recorded and excluded from the saved model's fitting rows.
